title: Creative Coding
blurb: Motion and image made from code alone. Watch the output, then open the source behind it.

works.title: Scrying Basin
works.desc: A crystal sphere pulses over a basin of black oil, and the ripples bend a rotating ceiling of sigils.
about: A generative occult motion piece written in pure NumPy and SciPy, with no image or video assets. Each time the sphere pulses it sends ripples across the oil, and the oil mirrors a rotating ceiling of sigils, a rune ring, a hexagram and star nodes. The ripples bend that reflection.

The sphere itself is a halftone RGB dot-matrix lens holding a miniature of the same sigil, ringed by chains of chromatic flares. Every motion is built from 6, 12, 36 or 180 fold symmetries, so the six second clip loops without a seam.
